1CH.28.10.t: Take heed now, for Yahweh has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”
s: Take heed now, for Yahweh has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”

1CH.28.11.t: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;
s: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;

1CH.28.12.t: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of Yahweh’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;
s: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of Yahweh’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;

1CH.28.13.t: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of Yahweh’s house, and for all the vessels of service in Yahweh’s house—
s: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of Yahweh’s house, and for all the vessels of service in Yahweh’s house—

1CH.28.14.t: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;
s: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;

1CH.28.15.t: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;
s: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;

1CH.28.16.t: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;
s: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;

1CH.28.17.t: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;
s: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;

1CH.28.18.t: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of Yahweh’s covenant.
s: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of Yahweh’s covenant.

1CH.28.19.t: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from Yahweh’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”
s: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from Yahweh’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”

1CH.28.20.t: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for Yahweh God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of Yahweh’s house is finished.
s: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for Yahweh God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of Yahweh’s house is finished.

1CH.28.21.t: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”
s: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”

1CO.9.19.t: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.
s: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

1CO.9.20.t: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;
s: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

1CO.9.21.t: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.
s: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

1CO.9.22.t: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.
s: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

1CO.9.23.t: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.
s: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

1CO.9.24.t: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.
s: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

1CO.9.25.t: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.
s: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

1CO.9.26.t: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,
s: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

1CO.9.27.t: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.
s: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.

1CO.10.6.t: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.
s: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

1CO.10.7.t: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”
s: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”

1CO.10.8.t: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.
s: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

1CO.10.9.t: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.
s: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

1CO.10.10.t: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.
s: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

1CO.10.11.t: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
s: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

1CO.10.12.t: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.
s: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

1CO.10.13.t: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
s: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

1CO.10.14.t: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
s: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

1CO.12.31.t: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
s: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

1CO.13.1.t: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
s: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

1CO.13.2.t: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.
s: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

1CO.13.3.t: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.
s: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

1CO.13.4.t: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
s: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

1CO.13.5.t: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;
s: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

1CO.13.6.t: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;
s: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

1CO.13.7.t: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.
s: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

1CO.13.8.t: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.
s: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

1CO.13.9.t: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;
s: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

1CO.13.10.t: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.
s: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

1CO.13.11.t: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.
s: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

1CO.13.12.t: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.
s: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

1CO.13.13.t: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
s: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

1CO.16.5.t: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.
s: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

1CO.16.6.t: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.
s: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

1CO.16.7.t: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
s: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

1CO.16.8.t: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,
s: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

1CO.16.9.t: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
s: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

1CO.16.10.t: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
s: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

1CO.16.11.t: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.
s: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

1CO.16.12.t: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.
s: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

1CO.16.13.t: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
s: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

1CO.16.14.t: Let all that you do be done in love.
s: Let all that you do be done in love.

1JN.1.5.t: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
s: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

1JN.1.6.t: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.
s: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.

1JN.1.7.t: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.
s: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.

1JN.1.8.t: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
s: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

1JN.1.9.t: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
s: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

1JN.1.10.t: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
s: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

1JN.2.1.t: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
s: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

1JN.2.2.t: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
s: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

1JN.2.28.t: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
s: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

1JN.2.29.t: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
s: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.

1JN.3.1.t: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
s: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

1JN.3.2.t: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
s: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

1JN.3.3.t: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
s: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

1JN.4.7.t: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
s: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

1JN.4.8.t: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
s: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

1JN.4.9.t: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
s: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.

1JN.4.10.t: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
s: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

1JN.4.11.t: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
s: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

1JN.4.12.t: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
s: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

1PE.2.4.t: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
s: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

1PE.2.5.t: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
s: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

1PE.2.6.t: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
s: Because it is contained in Scripture,
“Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious.
He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”

1PE.2.7.t: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”
s: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient,
“The stone which the builders rejected
has become the chief cornerstone,”

1PE.2.8.t: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.
s: and,
“a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.”
For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

1PE.2.9.t: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
s: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

1PE.2.10.t: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
s: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

1PE.3.8.t: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
s: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

1PE.3.9.t: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
s: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

1PE.3.10.t: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
s: For,
“He who would love life
and see good days,
let him keep his tongue from evil
and his lips from speaking deceit.

1PE.3.11.t: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.
s: Let him turn away from evil and do good.
Let him seek peace and pursue it.

1PE.3.12.t: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
s: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous,
and his ears open to their prayer;
but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

1PE.4.7.t: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
s: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

1PE.4.8.t: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
s: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

1PE.4.9.t: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
s: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

1PE.4.10.t: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
s: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

1PE.4.11.t: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
s: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

1PE.5.5.t: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
s: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

1PE.5.6.t: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
s: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

1PE.5.7.t: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
s: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

1PE.5.8.t: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
s: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

1PE.5.9.t: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
s: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

1PE.5.10.t: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
s: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

1PE.5.11.t: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
s: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

1SA.16.1.t: Yahweh said to Samuel, “How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him from being king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go. I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided a king for myself among his sons.”
s: Yahweh said to Samuel, “How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him from being king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go. I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided a king for myself among his sons.”

1SA.16.2.t: Samuel said, “How can I go? If Saul hears it, he will kill me.” Yahweh said, “Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh.’
s: Samuel said, “How can I go? If Saul hears it, he will kill me.”
Yahweh said, “Take a heifer with you, and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh.’

1SA.16.3.t: Call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do. You shall anoint to me him whom I name to you.”
s: Call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you shall do. You shall anoint to me him whom I name to you.”

1SA.16.4.t: Samuel did that which Yahweh spoke, and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling, and said, “Do you come peaceably?”
s: Samuel did that which Yahweh spoke, and came to Bethlehem. The elders of the city came to meet him trembling, and said, “Do you come peaceably?”

1SA.16.5.t: He said, “Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice.” He sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.
s: He said, “Peaceably; I have come to sacrifice to Yahweh. Sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice.” He sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

1SA.16.6.t: When they had come, he looked at Eliab, and said, “Surely Yahweh’s anointed is before him.”
s: When they had come, he looked at Eliab, and said, “Surely Yahweh’s anointed is before him.”

1SA.16.7.t: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”
s: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”

1SA.16.8.t: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”
s: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”

1SA.16.9.t: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”
s: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. He said, “Yahweh has not chosen this one, either.”

1SA.16.10.t: Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. Samuel said to Jesse, “Yahweh has not chosen these.”
s: Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. Samuel said to Jesse, “Yahweh has not chosen these.”

1SA.16.11.t: Samuel said to Jesse, “Are all your children here?” He said, “There remains yet the youngest. Behold, he is keeping the sheep.” Samuel said to Jesse, “Send and get him, for we will not sit down until he comes here.”
s: Samuel said to Jesse, “Are all your children here?”
He said, “There remains yet the youngest. Behold, he is keeping the sheep.”
Samuel said to Jesse, “Send and get him, for we will not sit down until he comes here.”

1SA.16.12.t: He sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with a handsome face and good appearance. Yahweh said, “Arise! Anoint him, for this is he.”
s: He sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with a handsome face and good appearance. Yahweh said, “Arise! Anoint him, for this is he.”

1SA.16.13.t: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the middle of his brothers. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up and went to Ramah.
s: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the middle of his brothers. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up and went to Ramah.

1TH.5.11.t: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
s: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

1TH.5.12.t: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,
s: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

1TH.5.13.t: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.
s: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake.
Be at peace among yourselves.

1TH.5.14.t: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.
s: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

1TH.5.15.t: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
s: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
Always rejoice.
Pray without ceasing.

1TH.5.18.t: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
s: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
Don’t quench the Spirit.
Don’t despise prophecies.

1TH.5.21.t: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
s: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

1TH.5.22.t: Abstain from every form of evil.
s: Abstain from every form of evil.

1TH.5.23.t: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
s: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

1TH.5.24.t: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
s: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
Command and teach these things.

1TI.4.12.t: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
s: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

1TI.4.13.t: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.
s: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

1TI.4.14.t: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.
s: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

1TI.4.15.t: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.
s: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

1TI.4.16.t: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
s: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

2CO.1.3.t: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,
s: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

2CO.1.4.t: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
s: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

2CO.1.5.t: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.
s: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

2CO.1.6.t: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.
s: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

2CO.1.7.t: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.
s: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

2CO.1.8.t: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.
s: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

2CO.1.9.t: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,
s: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

2CO.1.10.t: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,
s: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

2CO.1.11.t: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.
s: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

2CO.3.1.t: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?
s: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

2CO.3.2.t: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,
s: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

2CO.3.3.t: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.
s: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

2CO.3.4.t: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,
s: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

2CO.3.5.t: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,
s: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

2CO.3.6.t: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
s: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

2CO.12.7.t: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.
s: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

2CO.12.8.t: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
s: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

2CO.12.9.t: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
s: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

2CO.12.10.t: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
s: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

2SA.9.1.t: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”
s: David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”

2SA.9.2.t: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?” He said, “I am your servant.”
s: There was of Saul’s house a servant whose name was Ziba, and they called him to David; and the king said to him, “Are you Ziba?”
He said, “I am your servant.”

2SA.9.3.t: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?” Ziba said to the king, “Jonathan still has a son, who is lame in his feet.”
s: The king said, “Is there not yet any of Saul’s house, that I may show the kindness of God to him?”
Ziba said to the king, “Jonathan still has a son, who is lame in his feet.”

2SA.9.4.t: The king said to him, “Where is he?” Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”
s: The king said to him, “Where is he?”
Ziba said to the king, “Behold, he is in the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, in Lo Debar.”

2SA.9.5.t: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.
s: Then King David sent and brought him out of the house of Machir the son of Ammiel, from Lo Debar.

2SA.9.6.t: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?” He answered, “Behold, your servant!”
s: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth?”
He answered, “Behold, your servant!”

2SA.9.7.t: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”
s: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”

2SA.9.8.t: He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”
s: He bowed down, and said, “What is your servant, that you should look at such a dead dog as I am?”

2SA.9.9.t: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s son.
s: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said to him, “All that belonged to Saul and to all his house I have given to your master’s son.

2SA.9.10.t: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master’s son will always eat bread at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
s: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master’s son will always eat bread at my table.”
Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

2SA.9.11.t: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king’s table like one of the king’s sons.
s: Then Ziba said to the king, “According to all that my lord the king commands his servant, so your servant will do.” So Mephibosheth ate at the king’s table like one of the king’s sons.

2SA.9.12.t: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All who lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.
s: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All who lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.

2SA.9.13.t: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king’s table. He was lame in both his feet.
s: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, for he ate continually at the king’s table. He was lame in both his feet.

2TI.1.3.t: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day
s: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

2TI.1.4.t: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;
s: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

2TI.1.5.t: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.
s: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

2TI.1.6.t: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
s: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

2TI.1.7.t: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
s: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

2TI.1.8.t: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,
s: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

2TI.2.14.t: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.
s: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

2TI.2.15.t: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.
s: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

2TI.2.16.t: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,
s: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

2TI.2.17.t: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:
s: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

2TI.2.18.t: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.
s: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

2TI.2.19.t: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”
s: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

2TI.3.10.t: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
s: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

2TI.3.11.t: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.
s: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

2TI.3.12.t: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
s: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

2TI.3.13.t: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
s: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

2TI.3.14.t: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.
s: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

2TI.3.15.t: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
s: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

2TI.3.16.t: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,
s: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

2TI.3.17.t: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
s: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

COL.3.1.t: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
s: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

COL.3.2.t: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
s: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

COL.3.3.t: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
s: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

COL.3.4.t: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
s: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

COL.3.8.t: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
s: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

COL.3.9.t: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
s: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

COL.3.10.t: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
s: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

COL.3.11.t: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.
s: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

COL.3.12.t: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
s: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

COL.3.13.t: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
s: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

COL.3.14.t: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
s: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

COL.3.15.t: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
s: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

COL.3.16.t: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
s: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

COL.3.17.t: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
s: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

COL.3.22.t: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
s: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

COL.3.23.t: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
s: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

COL.3.24.t: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
s: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

COL.3.25.t: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
s: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

COL.4.1.t: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
s: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

DAN.1.3.t: The king spoke to Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of the royal offspring and of the nobles:
s: The king spoke to Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of the royal offspring and of the nobles:

DAN.1.4.t: youths in whom was no defect, but well-favored, skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding science, and who had the ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.
s: youths in whom was no defect, but well-favored, skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding science, and who had the ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.

DAN.1.5.t: The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s delicacies and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years, that at its end they should stand before the king.
s: The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s delicacies and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years, that at its end they should stand before the king.

DAN.1.6.t: Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
s: Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

DAN.1.7.t: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.
s: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.

DAN.1.8.t: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
s: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

DAN.1.9.t: Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.
s: Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.

DAN.1.10.t: The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, “I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? Then you would endanger my head with the king.”
s: The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, “I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? Then you would endanger my head with the king.”

DAN.1.11.t: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:
s: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

DAN.1.12.t: “Test your servants, I beg you, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.
s: “Test your servants, I beg you, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.

DAN.1.13.t: Then let our faces be examined before you, and the face of the youths who eat of the king’s delicacies; and as you see, deal with your servants.”
s: Then let our faces be examined before you, and the face of the youths who eat of the king’s delicacies; and as you see, deal with your servants.”

DAN.1.14.t: So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.
s: So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.

DAN.1.15.t: At the end of ten days, their faces appeared fairer and they were fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate of the king’s delicacies.
s: At the end of ten days, their faces appeared fairer and they were fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate of the king’s delicacies.

DAN.1.16.t: So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink, and gave them vegetables.
s: So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink, and gave them vegetables.

DAN.1.17.t: Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
s: Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

DAN.6.1.t: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom one hundred twenty local governors, who should be throughout the whole kingdom;
s: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom one hundred twenty local governors, who should be throughout the whole kingdom;

DAN.6.2.t: and over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one, that these local governors might give account to them, and that the king should suffer no loss.
s: and over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one, that these local governors might give account to them, and that the king should suffer no loss.

DAN.6.3.t: Then this Daniel was distinguished above the presidents and the local governors, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.
s: Then this Daniel was distinguished above the presidents and the local governors, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.

DAN.6.4.t: Then the presidents and the local governors sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they could find no occasion or fault, because he was faithful. There wasn’t any error or fault found in him.
s: Then the presidents and the local governors sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they could find no occasion or fault, because he was faithful. There wasn’t any error or fault found in him.

DAN.6.5.t: Then these men said, “We won’t find any occasion against this Daniel, unless we find it against him concerning the law of his God.”
s: Then these men said, “We won’t find any occasion against this Daniel, unless we find it against him concerning the law of his God.”

DAN.6.6.t: Then these presidents and local governors assembled together to the king, and said this to him, “King Darius, live forever!
s: Then these presidents and local governors assembled together to the king, and said this to him, “King Darius, live forever!

DAN.6.7.t: All the presidents of the kingdom, the deputies and the local governors, the counselors and the governors, have consulted together to establish a royal statute and to make a strong decree, that whoever asks a petition of any god or man for thirty days, except of you, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.
s: All the presidents of the kingdom, the deputies and the local governors, the counselors and the governors, have consulted together to establish a royal statute and to make a strong decree, that whoever asks a petition of any god or man for thirty days, except of you, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.

DAN.6.8.t: Now, O king, establish the decree and sign the writing, that it not be changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn’t alter.”
s: Now, O king, establish the decree and sign the writing, that it not be changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn’t alter.”

DAN.6.9.t: Therefore King Darius signed the writing and the decree.
s: Therefore King Darius signed the writing and the decree.

DAN.6.10.t: When Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house (now his windows were open in his room toward Jerusalem) and he kneeled on his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before.
s: When Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house (now his windows were open in his room toward Jerusalem) and he kneeled on his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before.

DEU.6.4.t: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.
s: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one.

DEU.6.5.t: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
s: You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

DEU.6.6.t: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
s: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;

DEU.6.7.t: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
s: and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.

DEU.6.8.t: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.
s: You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes.

DEU.6.9.t: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.
s: You shall write them on the door posts of your house and on your gates.

DEU.31.1.t: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.
s: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

DEU.31.2.t: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Yahweh has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’
s: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Yahweh has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’

DEU.31.3.t: Yahweh your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as Yahweh has spoken.
s: Yahweh your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as Yahweh has spoken.

DEU.31.4.t: Yahweh will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.
s: Yahweh will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.

DEU.31.5.t: Yahweh will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.
s: Yahweh will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.

DEU.31.6.t: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
s: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

ECC.3.1.t: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
s: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

ECC.3.2.t: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
s: a time to be born,
and a time to die;
a time to plant,
and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

ECC.3.3.t: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
s: a time to kill,
and a time to heal;
a time to break down,
and a time to build up;

ECC.3.4.t: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
s: a time to weep,
and a time to laugh;
a time to mourn,
and a time to dance;

ECC.3.5.t: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
s: a time to cast away stones,
and a time to gather stones together;
a time to embrace,
and a time to refrain from embracing;

ECC.3.6.t: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
s: a time to seek,
and a time to lose;
a time to keep,
and a time to cast away;

ECC.3.7.t: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
s: a time to tear,
and a time to sew;
a time to keep silence,
and a time to speak;

ECC.3.8.t: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.
s: a time to love,
and a time to hate;
a time for war,
and a time for peace.

ECC.3.9.t: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?
s: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?

ECC.3.10.t: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
s: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

ECC.3.11.t: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
s: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

ECC.4.7.t: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.
s: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

ECC.4.8.t: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.
s: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

ECC.4.9.t: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
s: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

ECC.4.10.t: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
s: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

ECC.4.11.t: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?
s: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?

ECC.4.12.t: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
s: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

ECC.9.7.t: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
s: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.

ECC.9.8.t: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.
s: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.

ECC.9.9.t: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.
s: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity, for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.

ECC.9.10.t: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.
s: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.

ECC.9.11.t: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.
s: I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.

EPH.2.4.t: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
s: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

EPH.2.5.t: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
s: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—

EPH.2.6.t: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,
s: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

EPH.2.7.t: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;
s: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

EPH.2.8.t: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
s: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

EPH.2.9.t: not of works, that no one would boast.
s: not of works, that no one would boast.

EPH.2.10.t: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
s: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

EPH.3.14.t: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
s: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

EPH.3.15.t: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,
s: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

EPH.3.16.t: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,
s: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

EPH.3.17.t: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,
s: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

EPH.3.18.t: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,
s: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

EPH.3.19.t: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
s: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

EPH.3.20.t: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
s: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

EPH.3.21.t: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
s: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

EPH.4.1.t: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
s: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

EPH.4.2.t: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
s: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

EPH.4.3.t: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
s: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

EPH.4.4.t: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,
s: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

EPH.4.5.t: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
s: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

EPH.4.6.t: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.
s: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

EPH.4.20.t: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,
s: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,

EPH.4.21.t: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:
s: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

EPH.4.22.t: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
s: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

EPH.4.23.t: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
s: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

EPH.4.24.t: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
s: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

EPH.4.25.t: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.
s: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

EPH.4.29.t: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
s: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

EPH.4.30.t: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
s: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

EPH.4.31.t: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
s: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

EPH.4.32.t: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
s: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

EPH.5.1.t: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
s: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

EPH.5.2.t: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
s: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

EXO.33.12.t: Moses said to Yahweh, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’
s: Moses said to Yahweh, “Behold, you tell me, ‘Bring up this people;’ and you haven’t let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have also found favor in my sight.’

EXO.33.13.t: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”
s: Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may find favor in your sight; and consider that this nation is your people.”

EXO.33.14.t: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
s: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

EXO.33.15.t: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.
s: Moses said to him, “If your presence doesn’t go with me, don’t carry us up from here.

EXO.33.16.t: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”
s: For how would people know that I have found favor in your sight, I and your people? Isn’t it that you go with us, so that we are separated, I and your people, from all the people who are on the surface of the earth?”

EXO.33.17.t: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”
s: Yahweh said to Moses, “I will do this thing also that you have spoken; for you have found favor in my sight, and I know you by name.”

GAL.5.16.t: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
s: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

GAL.5.17.t: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.
s: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

GAL.5.18.t: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
s: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

GAL.5.19.t: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
s: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

GAL.5.20.t: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
s: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

GAL.5.21.t: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.
s: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

GAL.5.22.t: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
s: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

GAL.5.23.t: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
s: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

GAL.5.24.t: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
s: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

GAL.5.25.t: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
s: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

GAL.5.26.t: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
s: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

GAL.6.1.t: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.
s: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

GAL.6.2.t: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
s: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

GAL.6.3.t: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
s: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
