GAL.6.4.t: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.
s: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

GAL.6.5.t: For each man will bear his own burden.
s: For each man will bear his own burden.

GAL.6.6.t: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
s: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

GAL.6.7.t: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
s: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

GAL.6.8.t: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
s: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

GAL.6.9.t: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.
s: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

GAL.6.10.t: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
s: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

GEN.28.10.t: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
s: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

GEN.28.11.t: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.
s: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

GEN.28.12.t: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
s: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

GEN.28.13.t: Behold, Yahweh stood above it, and said, “I am Yahweh, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.
s: Behold, Yahweh stood above it, and said, “I am Yahweh, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.

GEN.28.14.t: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.
s: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.

GEN.28.15.t: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”
s: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

GEN.28.16.t: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”
s: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”

GEN.28.17.t: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”
s: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”

HEB.4.12.t: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
s: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

HEB.4.13.t: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.
s: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

HEB.4.14.t: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.
s: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.

HEB.4.15.t: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
s: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

HEB.4.16.t: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
s: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

HEB.5.11.t: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
s: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

HEB.5.12.t: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.
s: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

HEB.5.13.t: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.
s: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

HEB.5.14.t: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
s: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

HEB.13.5.t: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
s: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

HEB.13.6.t: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
s: So that with good courage we say,
“The Lord is my helper. I will not fear.
What can man do to me?”

HEB.13.7.t: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.
s: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

HEB.13.8.t: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
s: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

HEB.13.9.t: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.
s: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

ISA.6.1.t: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
s: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

ISA.6.2.t: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.
s: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

ISA.6.3.t: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
s: One called to another, and said,
“Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies!
The whole earth is full of his glory!”

ISA.6.4.t: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.
s: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.

ISA.6.5.t: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”
s: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”

ISA.6.6.t: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.
s: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

ISA.6.7.t: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”
s: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”

ISA.6.8.t: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
s: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?”
Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”

ISA.26.1.t: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.
s: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah:
“We have a strong city.
God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.

ISA.26.2.t: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
s: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter:
the one which keeps faith.

ISA.26.3.t: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
s: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace,
because he trusts in you.

ISA.26.4.t: Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
s: Trust in Yahweh forever;
for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.

ISA.26.5.t: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.
s: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city.
He lays it low.
He lays it low even to the ground.
He brings it even to the dust.

ISA.26.6.t: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy.”
s: The foot shall tread it down,
even the feet of the poor
and the steps of the needy.”

ISA.26.7.t: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
s: The way of the just is uprightness.
You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.

ISA.26.8.t: Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
s: Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, we have waited for you.
Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.

ISA.26.9.t: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are on the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
s: With my soul I have desired you in the night.
Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly;
for when your judgments are on the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

ISA.30.18.t: Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for Yahweh is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.
s: Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for Yahweh is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.

ISA.30.19.t: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.
s: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.

ISA.30.20.t: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden any more, but your eyes will see your teachers;
s: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden any more, but your eyes will see your teachers;

ISA.30.21.t: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”
s: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

ISA.40.27.t: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from Yahweh, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God”?
s: Why do you say, Jacob,
and speak, Israel,
“My way is hidden from Yahweh,
and the justice due me is disregarded by my God”?

ISA.40.28.t: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.
s: Haven’t you known?
Haven’t you heard?
The everlasting God, Yahweh,
the Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint.
He isn’t weary.
His understanding is unsearchable.

ISA.40.29.t: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
s: He gives power to the weak.
He increases the strength of him who has no might.

ISA.40.30.t: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;
s: Even the youths faint and get weary,
and the young men utterly fall;

ISA.40.31.t: but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
s: but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength.
They will mount up with wings like eagles.
They will run, and not be weary.
They will walk, and not faint.

ISA.41.8.t: “But you, Israel, my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the offspring of Abraham my friend,
s: “But you, Israel, my servant,
Jacob whom I have chosen,
the offspring of Abraham my friend,

ISA.41.9.t: you whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my servant. I have chosen you and have not cast you away.’
s: you whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth,
and called from its corners,
and said to you, ‘You are my servant. I have chosen you and have not cast you away.’

ISA.41.10.t: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
s: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you.
Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God.
I will strengthen you.
Yes, I will help you.
Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

ISA.41.11.t: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.
s: Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded.
Those who strive with you will be like nothing, and shall perish.

ISA.41.12.t: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a nonexistent thing.
s: You will seek them, and won’t find them,
even those who contend with you.
Those who war against you will be as nothing,
as a nonexistent thing.

ISA.41.13.t: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
s: For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand,
saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid.
I will help you.’

ISA.42.10.t: Sing to Yahweh a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is therein, the islands and their inhabitants.
s: Sing to Yahweh a new song,
and his praise from the end of the earth,
you who go down to the sea,
and all that is therein,
the islands and their inhabitants.

ISA.42.11.t: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices, with the villages that Kedar inhabits. Let the inhabitants of Sela sing. Let them shout from the top of the mountains!
s: Let the wilderness and its cities raise their voices,
with the villages that Kedar inhabits.
Let the inhabitants of Sela sing.
Let them shout from the top of the mountains!

ISA.42.12.t: Let them give glory to Yahweh, and declare his praise in the islands.
s: Let them give glory to Yahweh,
and declare his praise in the islands.

ISA.42.13.t: Yahweh will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.
s: Yahweh will go out like a mighty man.
He will stir up zeal like a man of war.
He will raise a war cry.
Yes, he will shout aloud.
He will triumph over his enemies.

ISA.42.14.t: “I have been silent a long time. I have been quiet and restrained myself. Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I will both gasp and pant.
s: “I have been silent a long time.
I have been quiet and restrained myself.
Now I will cry out like a travailing woman. I will both gasp and pant.

ISA.42.15.t: I will destroy mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs. I will make the rivers islands, and will dry up the pools.
s: I will destroy mountains and hills,
and dry up all their herbs.
I will make the rivers islands,
and will dry up the pools.

ISA.42.16.t: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make darkness light before them, and crooked places straight. I will do these things, and I will not forsake them.
s: I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know.
I will lead them in paths that they don’t know.
I will make darkness light before them,
and crooked places straight.
I will do these things,
and I will not forsake them.

ISA.43.1.t: But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.
s: But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob,
and he who formed you, Israel, says:
“Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you.
I have called you by your name.
You are mine.

ISA.43.2.t: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
s: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you,
and through the rivers, they will not overflow you.
When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned,
and flame will not scorch you.

ISA.43.3.t: For I am Yahweh your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in your place.
s: For I am Yahweh your God,
the Holy One of Israel,
your Savior.
I have given Egypt as your ransom,
Ethiopia and Seba in your place.

ISA.43.4.t: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight, and I have loved you, therefore I will give people in your place, and nations instead of your life.
s: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight,
and I have loved you,
therefore I will give people in your place,
and nations instead of your life.

ISA.43.5.t: Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the east, and gather you from the west.
s: Don’t be afraid, for I am with you.
I will bring your offspring from the east,
and gather you from the west.

ISA.43.6.t: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’ and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back! Bring my sons from far away, and my daughters from the ends of the earth—
s: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’
and tell the south, ‘Don’t hold them back!
Bring my sons from far away,
and my daughters from the ends of the earth—

ISA.43.7.t: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.’”
s: everyone who is called by my name,
and whom I have created for my glory,
whom I have formed,
yes, whom I have made.’”

ISA.43.16.t: Yahweh, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters,
s: Yahweh, who makes a way in the sea,
and a path in the mighty waters,

ISA.43.17.t: who brings out the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick) says:
s: who brings out the chariot and horse,
the army and the mighty man
(they lie down together, they shall not rise;
they are extinct, they are quenched like a wick) says:

ISA.43.18.t: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.
s: “Don’t remember the former things,
and don’t consider the things of old.

ISA.43.19.t: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
s: Behold, I will do a new thing.
It springs out now.
Don’t you know it?
I will even make a way in the wilderness,
and rivers in the desert.

ISA.43.20.t: The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me, because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,
s: The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me,
because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert,
to give drink to my people, my chosen,

ISA.43.21.t: the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.
s: the people which I formed for myself,
that they might declare my praise.

JAS.1.2.t: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,
s: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

JAS.1.3.t: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
s: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

JAS.1.4.t: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
s: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

JAS.1.5.t: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
s: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

JAS.1.6.t: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.
s: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

JAS.1.7.t: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
s: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

JAS.1.8.t: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
s: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

JAS.1.12.t: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
s: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

JAS.1.13.t: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.
s: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

JAS.1.14.t: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
s: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

JAS.1.15.t: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
s: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

JAS.1.16.t: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.
s: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

JAS.1.17.t: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.
s: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

JAS.1.18.t: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
s: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

JAS.1.19.t: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
s: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

JAS.1.20.t: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
s: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

JAS.1.21.t: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
s: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

JAS.1.22.t: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
s: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

JAS.1.23.t: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;
s: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

JAS.1.24.t: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
s: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

JAS.1.25.t: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.
s: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

JAS.1.26.t: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.
s: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

JAS.1.27.t: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
s: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

JAS.4.1.t: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
s: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

JAS.4.2.t: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.
s: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

JAS.4.3.t: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.
s: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

JAS.4.4.t: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
s: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

JAS.4.5.t: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
s: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

JAS.4.6.t: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
s: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

JAS.4.7.t: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
s: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

JAS.4.8.t: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
s: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

JAS.4.9.t: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.
s: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.

JAS.4.10.t: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
s: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

JER.1.4.t: Now Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
s: Now Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

JER.1.5.t: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”
s: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you.
Before you were born, I sanctified you.
I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”

JER.1.6.t: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”
s: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”

JER.1.7.t: But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.
s: But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for you must go to whomever I send you, and you must say whatever I command you.

JER.1.8.t: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says Yahweh.
s: Don’t be afraid because of them, for I am with you to rescue you,” says Yahweh.

JER.1.9.t: Then Yahweh stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
s: Then Yahweh stretched out his hand and touched my mouth. Then Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.

JER.1.10.t: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”
s: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”

JER.17.5.t: Yahweh says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in man, relies on strength of flesh, and whose heart departs from Yahweh.
s: Yahweh says:
“Cursed is the man who trusts in man,
relies on strength of flesh,
and whose heart departs from Yahweh.

JER.17.6.t: For he will be like a bush in the desert, and will not see when good comes, but will inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, an uninhabited salt land.
s: For he will be like a bush in the desert,
and will not see when good comes,
but will inhabit the parched places in the wilderness,
an uninhabited salt land.

JER.17.7.t: “Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.
s: “Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh,
and whose confidence is in Yahweh.

JER.17.8.t: For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat comes, but its leaf will be green, and will not be concerned in the year of drought. It won’t cease from yielding fruit.
s: For he will be as a tree planted by the waters,
who spreads out its roots by the river,
and will not fear when heat comes,
but its leaf will be green,
and will not be concerned in the year of drought.
It won’t cease from yielding fruit.

JER.29.4.t: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says to all the captives whom I have caused to be carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon:
s: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says to all the captives whom I have caused to be carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon:

JER.29.5.t: “Build houses and dwell in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit.
s: “Build houses and dwell in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit.

JER.29.6.t: Take wives and father sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters. Multiply there, and don’t be diminished.
s: Take wives and father sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters. Multiply there, and don’t be diminished.

JER.29.7.t: Seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray to Yahweh for it; for in its peace you will have peace.”
s: Seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray to Yahweh for it; for in its peace you will have peace.”

JER.29.8.t: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Don’t let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you. Don’t listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.
s: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Don’t let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you. Don’t listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.

JER.29.9.t: For they prophesy falsely to you in my name. I have not sent them,” says Yahweh.
s: For they prophesy falsely to you in my name. I have not sent them,” says Yahweh.

JER.29.10.t: For Yahweh says, “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
s: For Yahweh says, “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

JER.29.11.t: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
s: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

JER.29.12.t: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.
s: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.

JER.29.13.t: You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
s: You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.

JER.29.14.t: I will be found by you,” says Yahweh, “and I will turn again your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places where I have driven you,” says Yahweh. “I will bring you again to the place from where I caused you to be carried away captive.”
s: I will be found by you,” says Yahweh, “and I will turn again your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places where I have driven you,” says Yahweh. “I will bring you again to the place from where I caused you to be carried away captive.”

JHN.3.9.t: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”
s: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

JHN.3.10.t: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?
s: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

JHN.3.11.t: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.
s: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

JHN.3.12.t: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
s: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

JHN.3.13.t: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
s: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

JHN.3.14.t: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
s: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

JHN.3.15.t: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
s: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

JHN.3.16.t: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
s: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

JHN.3.17.t: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
s: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

JHN.6.35.t: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
s: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

JHN.6.36.t: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
s: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.

JHN.6.37.t: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.
s: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

JHN.6.38.t: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.
s: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

JHN.6.39.t: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.
s: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

JHN.6.40.t: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”
s: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

JHN.11.32.t: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
s: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”

JHN.11.33.t: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,
s: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,

JHN.11.34.t: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”
s: and said, “Where have you laid him?”
They told him, “Lord, come and see.”
Jesus wept.

JHN.11.36.t: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”
s: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”

JHN.11.37.t: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
s: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”

JHN.13.1.t: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
s: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

JHN.13.2.t: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,
s: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,

JHN.13.3.t: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,
s: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

JHN.13.4.t: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.
s: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.

JHN.13.5.t: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
s: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

JHN.13.6.t: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
s: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”

JHN.13.7.t: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
s: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”

JHN.13.8.t: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”
s: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!”
Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”

JHN.13.9.t: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”
s: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”

JHN.13.10.t: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”
s: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”

JHN.13.11.t: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”
s: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”

JHN.13.12.t: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?
s: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?

JHN.13.13.t: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
s: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.

JHN.13.14.t: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
s: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

JHN.13.15.t: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.
s: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.

JHN.14.25.t: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.
s: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.

JHN.14.26.t: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
s: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

JHN.14.27.t: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
s: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

JHN.14.28.t: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
s: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.

JHN.14.29.t: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.
s: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.

JHN.14.30.t: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
s: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

JHN.14.31.t: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.
s: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.

JHN.15.9.t: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
s: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

JHN.15.10.t: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
s: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.

JHN.15.11.t: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
s: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

JHN.15.12.t: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
s: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

JHN.15.13.t: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
s: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

JHN.15.14.t: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.
s: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.

JHN.15.15.t: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
s: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

JHN.15.16.t: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
s: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

JHN.15.17.t: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
s: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

JHN.17.11.t: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
s: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

JHN.17.12.t: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
s: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

JHN.17.13.t: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
s: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

JHN.17.14.t: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
s: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

JHN.17.15.t: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
s: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

JHN.17.16.t: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
s: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

JHN.17.17.t: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
s: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

JHN.17.18.t: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
s: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

JHN.17.19.t: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
s: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

JHN.17.20.t: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,
s: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,

JHN.20.24.t: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.
s: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

JHN.20.25.t: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”
s: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!”
But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

JHN.20.26.t: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”
s: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

JHN.20.27.t: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”
s: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

JHN.20.28.t: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
s: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

JHN.20.29.t: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”
s: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

JHN.20.30.t: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
s: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

JHN.20.31.t: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
s: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

JHN.21.9.t: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
s: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

JHN.21.10.t: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”
s: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

JHN.21.11.t: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.
s: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

JHN.21.12.t: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.
s: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!”
None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

JHN.21.13.t: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
s: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

JHN.21.14.t: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
s: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

JHN.21.15.t: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
s: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?”
He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.”
He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

JHN.21.16.t: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
s: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?”
He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.”
He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

JHN.21.17.t: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
s: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?”
Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.”
Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

JOS.1.1.t: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahweh, Yahweh spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,
s: Now after the death of Moses the servant of Yahweh, Yahweh spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,

JOS.1.2.t: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am giving to them, even to the children of Israel.
s: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am giving to them, even to the children of Israel.

JOS.1.3.t: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.
s: I have given you every place that the sole of your foot will tread on, as I told Moses.

JOS.1.4.t: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.
s: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

JOS.1.5.t: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.
s: No man will be able to stand before you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you nor forsake you.

JOS.1.6.t: “Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.
s: “Be strong and courageous; for you shall cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.

JOS.1.7.t: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.
s: Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant commanded you. Don’t turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.

JOS.1.8.t: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
s: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.

JOS.1.9.t: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”
s: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”

JOS.24.14.t: “Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve Yahweh.
s: “Now therefore fear Yahweh, and serve him in sincerity and in truth. Put away the gods which your fathers served beyond the River, in Egypt; and serve Yahweh.

JOS.24.15.t: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”
s: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”

JOS.24.16.t: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake Yahweh, to serve other gods;
s: The people answered, “Far be it from us that we should forsake Yahweh, to serve other gods;

JOS.24.17.t: for it is Yahweh our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.
s: for it is Yahweh our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.

JOS.24.18.t: Yahweh drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve Yahweh; for he is our God.”
s: Yahweh drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve Yahweh; for he is our God.”

LAM.3.19.t: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
