MAT.6.10.t: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
s: Let your Kingdom come.
Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

MAT.6.11.t: Give us today our daily bread.
s: Give us today our daily bread.

MAT.6.12.t: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
s: Forgive us our debts,
as we also forgive our debtors.

MAT.6.13.t: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’
s: Bring us not into temptation,
but deliver us from the evil one.
For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’

MAT.6.14.t: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
s: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

MAT.6.15.t: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
s: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

MAT.6.25.t: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
s: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

MAT.6.26.t: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?
s: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?

MAT.6.27.t: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
s: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

MAT.6.28.t: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,
s: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,

MAT.6.29.t: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.
s: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

MAT.6.30.t: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?
s: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

MAT.6.31.t: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’
s: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’

MAT.6.32.t: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
s: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

MAT.6.33.t: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
s: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

MAT.6.34.t: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
s: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

MAT.7.7.t: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
s: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

MAT.7.8.t: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
s: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

MAT.7.9.t: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?
s: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

MAT.7.10.t: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?
s: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

MAT.7.11.t: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
s: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

MAT.10.29.t: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.
s: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.

MAT.11.25.t: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.
s: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

MAT.11.26.t: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.
s: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

MAT.11.27.t: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.
s: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

MAT.11.28.t: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
s: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

MAT.11.29.t: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
s: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

MAT.11.30.t: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
s: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

MAT.18.15.t: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.
s: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

MAT.18.16.t: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
s: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

MAT.18.17.t: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.
s: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.

MAT.18.18.t: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.
s: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

MAT.18.19.t: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.
s: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

MAT.18.20.t: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
s: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

MAT.18.21.t: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”
s: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

MAT.18.22.t: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.
s: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

MAT.25.14.t: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.
s: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.

MAT.25.15.t: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.
s: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

MAT.25.16.t: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.
s: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

MAT.25.17.t: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.
s: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

MAT.25.18.t: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.
s: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.

MAT.25.19.t: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.
s: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.

MAT.25.20.t: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’
s: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’

MAT.25.21.t: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
s: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

MAT.25.22.t: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’
s: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’

MAT.25.23.t: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
s: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

MAT.25.24.t: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.
s: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.

MAT.25.25.t: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’
s: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’

MAT.25.26.t: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.
s: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.

MAT.25.27.t: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.
s: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

MAT.25.28.t: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.
s: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.

MAT.25.29.t: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.
s: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.

MAT.25.30.t: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
s: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

MIC.6.1.t: Listen now to what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.
s: Listen now to what Yahweh says:
“Arise, plead your case before the mountains,
and let the hills hear what you have to say.

MIC.6.2.t: Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s indictment, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a case against his people, and he will contend with Israel.
s: Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s indictment,
and you enduring foundations of the earth;
for Yahweh has a case against his people,
and he will contend with Israel.

MIC.6.3.t: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!
s: My people, what have I done to you?
How have I burdened you?
Answer me!

MIC.6.4.t: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
s: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt,
and redeemed you out of the house of bondage.
I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

MIC.6.5.t: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of Yahweh.”
s: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised,
and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal,
that you may know the righteous acts of Yahweh.”

MIC.6.6.t: How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
s: How shall I come before Yahweh,
and bow myself before the exalted God?
Shall I come before him with burnt offerings,
with calves a year old?

MIC.6.7.t: Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
s: Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams?
With tens of thousands of rivers of oil?
Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience?
The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

MIC.6.8.t: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
s: He has shown you, O man, what is good.
What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly,
to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

MRK.10.13.t: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.
s: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

MRK.10.14.t: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
s: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

MRK.10.15.t: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
s: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

MRK.10.16.t: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.
s: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

MRK.10.35.t: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”
s: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”

MRK.10.36.t: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”
s: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

MRK.10.37.t: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”
s: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”

MRK.10.38.t: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”
s: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”

MRK.10.39.t: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;
s: They said to him, “We are able.”
Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

MRK.10.40.t: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”
s: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”

MRK.10.41.t: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.
s: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.

MRK.10.42.t: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
s: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

MRK.10.43.t: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.
s: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

MRK.10.44.t: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.
s: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.

MRK.10.45.t: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
s: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

NUM.6.23.t: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,
s: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,
‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you.

NUM.6.25.t: Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.
s: Yahweh make his face to shine on you,
and be gracious to you.

NUM.6.26.t: Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’
s: Yahweh lift up his face toward you,
and give you peace.’

NUM.6.27.t: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”
s: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”

PHP.1.3.t: I thank my God whenever I remember you,
s: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

PHP.1.4.t: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
s: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

PHP.1.5.t: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;
s: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

PHP.1.6.t: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
s: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

PHP.1.7.t: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.
s: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

PHP.1.8.t: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
s: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

PHP.1.9.t: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
s: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

PHP.1.10.t: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
s: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

PHP.1.11.t: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
s: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

PHP.2.1.t: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
s: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

PHP.2.2.t: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
s: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

PHP.2.3.t: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
s: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

PHP.2.4.t: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
s: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

PHP.2.5.t: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
s: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

PHP.2.6.t: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
s: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

PHP.2.7.t: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
s: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

PHP.2.8.t: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
s: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

PHP.2.9.t: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
s: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

PHP.2.10.t: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
s: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

PHP.2.11.t: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
s: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

PHP.4.4.t: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
s: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

PHP.4.5.t: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
s: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

PHP.4.6.t: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
s: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

PHP.4.7.t: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
s: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

PHP.4.8.t: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
s: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

PHP.4.9.t: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.
s: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

PHP.4.10.t: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.
s: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

PHP.4.11.t: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
s: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

PHP.4.12.t: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.
s: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

PHP.4.13.t: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
s: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

PHP.4.14.t: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.
s: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

s: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

PRO.1.2.t: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
s: to know wisdom and instruction;
to discern the words of understanding;

PRO.1.3.t: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
s: to receive instruction in wise dealing,
in righteousness, justice, and equity;

PRO.1.4.t: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—
s: to give prudence to the simple,
knowledge and discretion to the young man—

PRO.1.5.t: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;
s: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning;
that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

PRO.1.6.t: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
s: to understand a proverb and parables,
the words and riddles of the wise.

PRO.1.7.t: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
s: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge,
but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

PRO.1.8.t: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;
s: My son, listen to your father’s instruction,
and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;

PRO.1.9.t: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
s: for they will be a garland to grace your head,
and chains around your neck.

PRO.2.1.t: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
s: My son, if you will receive my words,
and store up my commandments within you,

PRO.2.2.t: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
s: so as to turn your ear to wisdom,
and apply your heart to understanding;

PRO.2.3.t: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
s: yes, if you call out for discernment,
and lift up your voice for understanding;

PRO.2.4.t: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;
s: if you seek her as silver,
and search for her as for hidden treasures;

PRO.2.5.t: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.
s: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh,
and find the knowledge of God.

PRO.2.6.t: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
s: For Yahweh gives wisdom.
Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

PRO.2.7.t: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,
s: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright.
He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

PRO.2.8.t: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
s: that he may guard the paths of justice,
and preserve the way of his saints.

PRO.2.9.t: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
s: Then you will understand righteousness and justice,
equity and every good path.

PRO.2.10.t: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
s: For wisdom will enter into your heart.
Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

PRO.2.11.t: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
s: Discretion will watch over you.
Understanding will keep you,

PRO.3.1.t: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,
s: My son, don’t forget my teaching,
but let your heart keep my commandments,

PRO.3.2.t: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
s: for they will add to you length of days,
years of life, and peace.

PRO.3.3.t: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
s: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you.
Bind them around your neck.
Write them on the tablet of your heart.

PRO.3.4.t: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
s: So you will find favor,
and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

PRO.3.5.t: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
s: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart,
and don’t lean on your own understanding.

PRO.3.6.t: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
s: In all your ways acknowledge him,
and he will make your paths straight.

PRO.3.7.t: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
s: Don’t be wise in your own eyes.
Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.

PRO.3.8.t: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
s: It will be health to your body,
and nourishment to your bones.

PRO.3.21.t: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,
s: My son, let them not depart from your eyes.
Keep sound wisdom and discretion,

PRO.3.22.t: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
s: so they will be life to your soul,
and grace for your neck.

PRO.3.23.t: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
s: Then you shall walk in your way securely.
Your foot won’t stumble.

PRO.3.24.t: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
s: When you lie down, you will not be afraid.
Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

PRO.3.25.t: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;
s: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear,
neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

PRO.3.26.t: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
s: for Yahweh will be your confidence,
and will keep your foot from being taken.

PRO.4.1.t: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
s: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction.
Pay attention and know understanding;

PRO.4.2.t: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
s: for I give you sound learning.
Don’t forsake my law.

PRO.4.3.t: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.
s: For I was a son to my father,
tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

PRO.4.4.t: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
s: He taught me, and said to me:
“Let your heart retain my words.
Keep my commandments, and live.

PRO.4.5.t: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.
s: Get wisdom.
Get understanding.
Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

PRO.4.6.t: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
s: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you.
Love her, and she will keep you.

PRO.4.7.t: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
s: Wisdom is supreme.
Get wisdom.
Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

PRO.4.8.t: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.
s: Esteem her, and she will exalt you.
She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

PRO.4.9.t: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
s: She will give to your head a garland of grace.
She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

PRO.4.20.t: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
s: My son, attend to my words.
Turn your ear to my sayings.

PRO.4.21.t: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.
s: Let them not depart from your eyes.
Keep them in the center of your heart.

PRO.4.22.t: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
s: For they are life to those who find them,
and health to their whole body.

PRO.4.23.t: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
s: Keep your heart with all diligence,
for out of it is the wellspring of life.

PRO.4.24.t: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
s: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth.
Put corrupt lips far from you.

PRO.4.25.t: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
s: Let your eyes look straight ahead.
Fix your gaze directly before you.

PRO.4.26.t: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
s: Make the path of your feet level.
Let all of your ways be established.

PRO.4.27.t: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
s: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left.
Remove your foot from evil.

PRO.6.6.t: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
s: Go to the ant, you sluggard.
Consider her ways, and be wise;

PRO.6.7.t: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
s: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

PRO.6.8.t: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
s: provides her bread in the summer,
and gathers her food in the harvest.

PRO.6.9.t: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
s: How long will you sleep, sluggard?
When will you arise out of your sleep?

PRO.6.10.t: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—
s: A little sleep, a little slumber,
a little folding of the hands to sleep—

PRO.6.11.t: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
s: so your poverty will come as a robber,
and your scarcity as an armed man.

PRO.9.1.t: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
s: Wisdom has built her house.
She has carved out her seven pillars.

PRO.9.2.t: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
s: She has prepared her meat.
She has mixed her wine.
She has also set her table.

PRO.9.3.t: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:
s: She has sent out her maidens.
She cries from the highest places of the city:

PRO.9.4.t: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
s: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!”
As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

PRO.9.5.t: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!
s: “Come, eat some of my bread,
Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

PRO.9.6.t: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
s: Leave your simple ways, and live.
Walk in the way of understanding.”

PRO.9.7.t: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
s: One who corrects a mocker invites insult.
One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

PRO.9.8.t: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
s: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you.
Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

PRO.9.9.t: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
s: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser.
Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

PRO.9.10.t: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
s: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom.
The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

PRO.9.11.t: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
s: For by me your days will be multiplied.
The years of your life will be increased.

PRO.9.12.t: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
s: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself.
If you mock, you alone will bear it.

PRO.10.1.t: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
s: The proverbs of Solomon.
A wise son makes a glad father;
but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

PRO.10.2.t: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
s: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing,
but righteousness delivers from death.

PRO.10.3.t: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
s: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry,
but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

PRO.10.4.t: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
s: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand,
but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

PRO.10.5.t: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
s: He who gathers in summer is a wise son,
but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

PRO.10.6.t: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
s: Blessings are on the head of the righteous,
but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

PRO.10.7.t: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.
s: The memory of the righteous is blessed,
but the name of the wicked will rot.

PRO.10.8.t: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
s: The wise in heart accept commandments,
but a chattering fool will fall.

PRO.10.9.t: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
s: He who walks blamelessly walks surely,
but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

PRO.11.9.t: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.
s: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor,
but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

PRO.11.10.t: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
s: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices.
When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

PRO.11.11.t: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
s: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted,
but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

PRO.11.12.t: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.
s: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom,
but a man of understanding holds his peace.

PRO.11.13.t: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
s: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence,
but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

PRO.11.14.t: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.
s: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls,
but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

PRO.12.17.t: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.
s: He who is truthful testifies honestly,
but a false witness lies.

PRO.12.18.t: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
s: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword,
but the tongue of the wise heals.

PRO.12.19.t: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.
s: Truth’s lips will be established forever,
but a lying tongue is only momentary.

PRO.12.20.t: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.
s: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil,
but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

PRO.12.21.t: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
s: No mischief shall happen to the righteous,
but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

PRO.12.22.t: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.
s: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh,
but those who do the truth are his delight.

PRO.13.14.t: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
s: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life,
to turn from the snares of death.

PRO.13.15.t: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
s: Good understanding wins favor,
but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

PRO.13.16.t: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
s: Every prudent man acts from knowledge,
but a fool exposes folly.

PRO.13.17.t: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
s: A wicked messenger falls into trouble,
but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

PRO.13.18.t: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
s: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline,
but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

PRO.13.19.t: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
s: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul,
but fools detest turning from evil.

PRO.13.20.t: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
s: One who walks with wise men grows wise,
but a companion of fools suffers harm.

PRO.15.1.t: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
s: A gentle answer turns away wrath,
but a harsh word stirs up anger.

PRO.15.2.t: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.
s: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge,
but the mouths of fools gush out folly.

PRO.15.3.t: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
s: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere,
keeping watch on the evil and the good.

PRO.15.4.t: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
s: A gentle tongue is a tree of life,
but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

PRO.16.1.t: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.
s: The plans of the heart belong to man,
but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.

PRO.16.2.t: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the motives.
s: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes,
but Yahweh weighs the motives.

PRO.16.3.t: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
s: Commit your deeds to Yahweh,
and your plans shall succeed.

PRO.16.4.t: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.
s: Yahweh has made everything for its own end—
yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

PRO.16.5.t: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh; they shall certainly not be unpunished.
s: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahweh;
they shall certainly not be unpunished.

PRO.16.6.t: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
s: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for.
By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.

PRO.16.7.t: When a man’s ways please Yahweh, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
s: When a man’s ways please Yahweh,
he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

PRO.16.8.t: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
s: Better is a little with righteousness,
than great revenues with injustice.

PRO.16.9.t: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
s: A man’s heart plans his course,
but Yahweh directs his steps.

PRO.16.21.t: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.
s: The wise in heart shall be called prudent.
Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

PRO.16.22.t: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.
s: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it,
but the punishment of fools is their folly.

PRO.16.23.t: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.
s: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth,
and adds learning to his lips.

PRO.16.24.t: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
s: Pleasant words are a honeycomb,
sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

PRO.16.27.t: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.
s: A worthless man devises mischief.
His speech is like a scorching fire.

PRO.16.28.t: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.
s: A perverse man stirs up strife.
A whisperer separates close friends.

PRO.16.29.t: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
s: A man of violence entices his neighbor,
and leads him in a way that is not good.

PRO.16.30.t: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.
s: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities,
one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

PRO.16.31.t: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.
s: Gray hair is a crown of glory.
It is attained by a life of righteousness.

PRO.16.32.t: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
s: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty;
one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

PRO.17.9.t: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
s: He who covers an offense promotes love;
but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

PRO.17.10.t: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
s: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding
than a hundred lashes into a fool.

PRO.17.11.t: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
s: An evil man seeks only rebellion;
therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

PRO.17.12.t: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
s: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man,
rather than a fool in his folly.

PRO.17.13.t: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
s: Whoever rewards evil for good,
evil shall not depart from his house.

PRO.17.14.t: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
s: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam,
therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

s: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous,
both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

PRO.17.16.t: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
s: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom,
since he has no understanding?

PRO.17.17.t: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
s: A friend loves at all times;
and a brother is born for adversity.

PRO.18.10.t: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
s: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower:
the righteous run to him, and are safe.

PRO.18.11.t: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
s: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city,
like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

PRO.18.12.t: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
s: Before destruction the heart of man is proud,
but before honor is humility.

PRO.19.20.t: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
s: Listen to counsel and receive instruction,
that you may be wise in your latter end.

PRO.19.21.t: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
s: There are many plans in a man’s heart,
but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.

PRO.19.22.t: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
s: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness.
A poor man is better than a liar.

PRO.19.23.t: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
s: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment;
he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

PRO.22.1.t: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
s: A good name is more desirable than great riches,
and loving favor is better than silver and gold.

PRO.22.2.t: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.
s: The rich and the poor have this in common:
Yahweh is the maker of them all.

PRO.22.3.t: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
s: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself;
but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

PRO.22.4.t: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.
s: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh
is wealth, honor, and life.

PRO.22.5.t: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.
s: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked;
whoever guards his soul stays far from them.

PRO.24.15.t: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place;
s: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous.
Don’t destroy his resting place;

PRO.24.16.t: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
s: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again,
but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

PRO.24.17.t: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,
s: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls.
Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,

PRO.24.18.t: lest Yahweh see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
s: lest Yahweh see it, and it displease him,
and he turn away his wrath from him.

PRO.27.5.t: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
s: Better is open rebuke
than hidden love.

PRO.27.6.t: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
s: The wounds of a friend are faithful,
although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.

PRO.27.7.t: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.
s: A full soul loathes a honeycomb;
but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.

PRO.27.8.t: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.
s: As a bird that wanders from her nest,
so is a man who wanders from his home.

PRO.27.9.t: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
s: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart;
so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.

PRO.27.10.t: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.
s: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend.
Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster.
A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.

PRO.27.11.t: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.
s: Be wise, my son,
and bring joy to my heart,
then I can answer my tormentor.

PRO.27.12.t: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
s: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge;
but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

PRO.27.13.t: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!
s: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger.
Hold it for a wayward woman!

PRO.27.14.t: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.
s: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning,
it will be taken as a curse by him.

PRO.27.15.t: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:
s: A continual dropping on a rainy day
and a contentious wife are alike:

PRO.27.16.t: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.
s: restraining her is like restraining the wind,
or like grasping oil in his right hand.

PRO.27.17.t: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
s: Iron sharpens iron;
so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

PRO.31.1.t: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:
s: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:

PRO.31.2.t: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
s: “Oh, my son!
Oh, son of my womb!
Oh, son of my vows!

PRO.31.3.t: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
s: Don’t give your strength to women,
nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

PRO.31.4.t: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
s: It is not for kings, Lemuel,
it is not for kings to drink wine,
nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’

PRO.31.5.t: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
s: lest they drink, and forget the law,
and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.

PRO.31.6.t: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.
s: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish,
and wine to the bitter in soul.

PRO.31.7.t: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
s: Let him drink, and forget his poverty,
and remember his misery no more.

PRO.31.8.t: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
s: Open your mouth for the mute,
in the cause of all who are left desolate.

PRO.31.9.t: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
s: Open your mouth, judge righteously,
and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

PRO.31.25.t: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
s: Strength and dignity are her clothing.
She laughs at the time to come.

PRO.31.26.t: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.
s: She opens her mouth with wisdom.
Kind instruction is on her tongue.

PRO.31.27.t: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
s: She looks well to the ways of her household,
and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

PRO.31.28.t: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
s: Her children rise up and call her blessed.
Her husband also praises her:

PRO.31.29.t: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”
s: “Many women do noble things,
but you excel them all.”

PRO.31.30.t: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
s: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain;
but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.

PRO.31.31.t: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
s: Give her of the fruit of her hands!
Let her works praise her in the gates!

PSA.3.1.t: Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
s: Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased!
Many are those who rise up against me.
PSA.3.1.h: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son.

PSA.3.2.t: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.
s: Many there are who say of my soul,
“There is no help for him in God.” Selah.

PSA.3.3.t: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
s: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me,
my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

PSA.3.4.t: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.
s: I cry to Yahweh with my voice,
and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

PSA.3.5.t: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for Yahweh sustains me.
s: I laid myself down and slept.
I awakened, for Yahweh sustains me.

PSA.3.6.t: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.
s: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people
who have set themselves against me on every side.

PSA.4.1.t: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
s: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness.
Give me relief from my distress.
Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
PSA.4.1.h: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David.

PSA.4.2.t: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.
s: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor?
Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.

PSA.4.3.t: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly; Yahweh will hear when I call to him.
s: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly;
Yahweh will hear when I call to him.

PSA.4.4.t: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.
s: Stand in awe, and don’t sin.
Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

PSA.4.5.t: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.
s: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness.
Put your trust in Yahweh.

PSA.4.6.t: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
s: Many say, “Who will show us any good?”
Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.

PSA.4.7.t: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.
s: You have put gladness in my heart,
more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

PSA.4.8.t: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.
s: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep,
for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.

PSA.5.1.t: Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.
s: Give ear to my words, Yahweh.
Consider my meditation.
PSA.5.1.h: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David.

PSA.5.2.t: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.
s: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God,
for I pray to you.

PSA.5.3.t: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
s: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice.
In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

PSA.5.4.t: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.
s: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness.
Evil can’t live with you.

PSA.5.5.t: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.
s: The arrogant will not stand in your sight.
You hate all workers of iniquity.

PSA.5.6.t: You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
s: You will destroy those who speak lies.
Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

PSA.5.7.t: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.
s: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house.
I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

PSA.5.8.t: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
s: Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies.
Make your way straight before my face.

PSA.5.9.t: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.
s: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth.
Their heart is destruction.
Their throat is an open tomb.
They flatter with their tongue.

PSA.5.10.t: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.
s: Hold them guilty, God.
Let them fall by their own counsels.
Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions,
for they have rebelled against you.

PSA.5.11.t: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.
s: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice.
Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them.
Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

PSA.5.12.t: For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
s: For you will bless the righteous.
Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.

PSA.9.7.t: But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
s: But Yahweh reigns forever.
He has prepared his throne for judgment.

PSA.9.8.t: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
s: He will judge the world in righteousness.
He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

PSA.9.9.t: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.
s: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed;
a high tower in times of trouble.

PSA.9.10.t: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
s: Those who know your name will put their trust in you,
for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.

PSA.9.11.t: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.
s: Sing praises to Yahweh, who dwells in Zion,
and declare among the people what he has done.

PSA.9.12.t: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
s: For he who avenges blood remembers them.
He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

PSA.10.12.t: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
s: Arise, Yahweh!
God, lift up your hand!
Don’t forget the helpless.

PSA.10.13.t: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?
s: Why does the wicked person condemn God,
and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?

PSA.10.14.t: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
s: But you do see trouble and grief.
You consider it to take it into your hand.
You help the victim and the fatherless.

PSA.10.15.t: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
s: Break the arm of the wicked.
As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

PSA.10.16.t: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
s: Yahweh is King forever and ever!
The nations will perish out of his land.

PSA.10.17.t: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
s: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble.
You will prepare their heart.
You will cause your ear to hear,

PSA.10.18.t: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
s: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed,
that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

PSA.16.1.t: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.
s: Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

PSA.16.2.t: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
s: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord.
Apart from you I have no good thing.”

PSA.16.3.t: As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
s: As for the saints who are on the earth,
they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

PSA.16.4.t: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.
s: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god.
Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer,
nor take their names on my lips.

PSA.16.5.t: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
s: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup.
You made my lot secure.

PSA.16.6.t: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.
s: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places.
Yes, I have a good inheritance.

PSA.16.7.t: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.
s: I will bless Yahweh, who has given me counsel.
Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

PSA.16.8.t: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
s: I have set Yahweh always before me.
Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

PSA.16.9.t: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.
s: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices.
My body shall also dwell in safety.

PSA.16.10.t: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.
s: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol,
neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

PSA.16.11.t: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
s: You will show me the path of life.
In your presence is fullness of joy.
In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

PSA.19.1.t: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
s: The heavens declare the glory of God.
The expanse shows his handiwork.
PSA.19.1.h: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

PSA.19.2.t: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.
s: Day after day they pour out speech,
and night after night they display knowledge.

PSA.19.3.t: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.
s: There is no speech nor language
where their voice is not heard.

PSA.19.4.t: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,
s: Their voice has gone out through all the earth,
their words to the end of the world.
In them he has set a tent for the sun,

PSA.19.5.t: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.
s: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room,
like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

PSA.19.6.t: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.
s: His going out is from the end of the heavens,
his circuit to its ends.
There is nothing hidden from its heat.

PSA.19.7.t: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
s: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul.
Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

PSA.19.8.t: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
s: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart.
Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

PSA.19.9.t: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.
s: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever.
Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

PSA.19.10.t: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.
s: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold,
sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

PSA.19.11.t: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.
s: Moreover your servant is warned by them.
In keeping them there is great reward.

PSA.19.12.t: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.
s: Who can discern his errors?
Forgive me from hidden errors.

PSA.19.13.t: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.
s: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins.
Let them not have dominion over me.
Then I will be upright.
I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

PSA.19.14.t: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
s: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart
be acceptable in your sight,
Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.

PSA.23.1.t: Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
s: Yahweh is my shepherd;
I shall lack nothing.

PSA.23.2.t: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
s: He makes me lie down in green pastures.
He leads me beside still waters.

PSA.23.3.t: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
s: He restores my soul.
He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

PSA.23.4.t: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
s: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,
I will fear no evil, for you are with me.
Your rod and your staff,
they comfort me.

PSA.23.5.t: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
s: You prepare a table before me
in the presence of my enemies.
You anoint my head with oil.
My cup runs over.

PSA.23.6.t: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.
s: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life,
and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.

PSA.25.1.t: To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.
s: To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.

PSA.25.2.t: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
s: My God, I have trusted in you.
Don’t let me be shamed.
Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

PSA.25.3.t: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
s: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed.
They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

PSA.25.4.t: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
s: Show me your ways, Yahweh.
Teach me your paths.

PSA.25.5.t: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
s: Guide me in your truth, and teach me,
for you are the God of my salvation.
I wait for you all day long.

PSA.25.6.t: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
s: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness,
for they are from old times.

PSA.25.7.t: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.
s: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions.
Remember me according to your loving kindness,
for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.

PSA.25.8.t: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
s: Good and upright is Yahweh,
therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

PSA.25.9.t: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
s: He will guide the humble in justice.
He will teach the humble his way.

PSA.25.10.t: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
s: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth
to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

PSA.25.14.t: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
s: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him.
He will show them his covenant.

PSA.25.15.t: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
s: My eyes are ever on Yahweh,
for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

PSA.25.16.t: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
s: Turn to me, and have mercy on me,
for I am desolate and afflicted.

PSA.25.17.t: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
s: The troubles of my heart are enlarged.
Oh bring me out of my distresses.

PSA.25.18.t: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
s: Consider my affliction and my travail.
Forgive all my sins.

PSA.25.19.t: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
s: Consider my enemies, for they are many.
They hate me with cruel hatred.

PSA.25.20.t: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
s: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me.
Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

PSA.25.21.t: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
s: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me,
for I wait for you.

PSA.27.1.t: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
s: Yahweh is my light and my salvation.
Whom shall I fear?
Yahweh is the strength of my life.
Of whom shall I be afraid?

PSA.27.2.t: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
s: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh,
even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

PSA.27.3.t: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.
s: Though an army should encamp against me,
my heart shall not fear.
Though war should rise against me,
even then I will be confident.

PSA.27.4.t: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life, to see Yahweh’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
s: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after:
that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life,
to see Yahweh’s beauty,
and to inquire in his temple.

PSA.27.5.t: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.
s: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion.
In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me.
He will lift me up on a rock.

PSA.27.7.t: Hear, Yahweh, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
s: Hear, Yahweh, when I cry with my voice.
Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

PSA.27.8.t: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”
s: When you said, “Seek my face,”
my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”

PSA.27.9.t: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.
s: Don’t hide your face from me.
Don’t put your servant away in anger.
You have been my help.
Don’t abandon me,
neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

PSA.27.10.t: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahweh will take me up.
s: When my father and my mother forsake me,
then Yahweh will take me up.

PSA.27.11.t: Teach me your way, Yahweh. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
s: Teach me your way, Yahweh.
Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

PSA.27.12.t: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.
s: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries,
for false witnesses have risen up against me,
such as breathe out cruelty.

PSA.27.13.t: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.
s: I am still confident of this:
I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living.

PSA.27.14.t: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
s: Wait for Yahweh.
Be strong, and let your heart take courage.
Yes, wait for Yahweh.

PSA.31.9.t: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
s: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress.
My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

PSA.31.10.t: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.
s: For my life is spent with sorrow,
my years with sighing.
My strength fails because of my iniquity.
My bones are wasted away.
